edit.hint: Drag on empty areas to add a box · drag a box to move it · drag its edges or corners to resize · Del removes the selected box · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undo/redo · ←/→ switch pages. Then confirm to re-run the whole pipeline with your boxes.
hero.meta: Free · Open source · No sign-up · Runs 100% in your browser
hero.sub: Upload a PDF, extract highlighted text, and get a clean Markdown document ready to use.
hero.title: From PDF to Markdown
how.step1.d: Drag or select a PDF with highlighted text of any color.
how.step2.d: The tool analyzes annotations and finds highlighted text.
how.step3.d: Copy or download the result as a Markdown file.
how.title: How it works
noHighlights.hint: Make sure the PDF contains highlight annotations of any color (Adobe Acrobat, Preview, Edge, …) or clearly marked text.
noHighlights.title: 😕 No highlights found in this PDF.
result.title: Highlights found
upload.hint: All processing happens in your browser — no data is sent to any server
